# Copilot instructions

Read and follow **`AGENTS.md`** at the repo root. It is the single source of truth for agent rules in this repo:

- work only on `<member>/<topic>` branches;
- never commit to `main`;
- no `Co-authored-by` or attribution lines;
- no data files;
- no external data or APIs;
- write a handover at the end of each session.
